clips.title: The story
paras: Blackfathom Villainy is an urgent plea delivered by a dying Argent Dawn crusader trapped inside Blackfathom Deeps. Horde adventurers are charged with putting an end to Twilight Lord Kelris, the cult leader orchestrating horrific blood sacrifices to an ancient monstrosity in the ruins below.

Drawn to the subterranean temple along the Ashenvale coast, the Argent Dawn scout Thaelrid discovered horrors far worse than simple naga incursions. Wounded and stripped of strength within the caverns, the night elf realizes he cannot finish his mission alone. Rather than letting his reconnaissance die with him, he turns to any passing Horde champions willing to strike at the dark leadership presiding over the sunken halls.

The target of the task is Twilight Lord Kelris, the head of the Twilight's Hammer cultists who have entrenched themselves within the ruined Temple of the Moon. Allied with the local naga, Kelris conducts dark rituals over the defiled Moon Well, feeding living captives to Aku'mai—a ravenous hydra and beast of the Old Gods—in a mad pursuit of cosmic power and primordial chaos.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Strength has left me. Your help is needed!
Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.
Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.
The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.
Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, friend, please.

clips.title: Progress
paras: May the Earthmother be with you, friend.
Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.
For some time they considered him dead or missing.
By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, friend.
Earthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!
You have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, friend.
